mapper.select: SELECT dict_code, dict_name, description, built_in, enabled, sort_order FROM platform.sys_dictionary ORDER BY sort_order, dict_code
SELECT dict_code, item_code, item_label, sort_order, built_in, enabled FROM platform.sys_dictionary_item WHERE dict_code = #{dictCode} ORDER BY sort_order, item_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform.sys_dictionary (dict_code, dict_name, description, built_in, enabled, sort_order) VALUES (#{dictCode}, #{dictName}, #{description}, FALSE, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE platform.sys_dictionary SET dict_name = #{dictName}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE dict_code = #{dictCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform.sys_dictionary_item (dict_code, item_code, item_label, sort_order, built_in, enabled) VALUES (#{dictCode}, #{itemCode}, #{itemLabel}, #{sortOrder}, #{builtIn}, #{enabled}) ON CONFLICT (dict_code, item_code) DO UPDATE SET item_label = EXCLUDED.item_label, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, updated_at = now(), version = platform.sys_dictionary_item.version + 1
